name: nimbora-provisioning
description: Operator account of the shared PBX: creates each company's tenant, contexts and service account. Granted together with every ACL of integration-policy.json (an account can only hand out what it holds). Also keeps the ACLs a former NIMBORA granted to companies (retired_acl): wazo-auth lets an account update a policy or give it to a user only if it holds every ACL in it, so provisioning can remove them from older companies.
